title: doc-to-markdown — Phase 4 Export/Import UAT
description: Browser-driven execution of the 10 pending manual UAT cases for the export/import feature (export dropdown, full + outputs-only ZIP, spinner, import round-trip, name-collision auto-rename, status feedback, invalid-file rejection). ZIP round-trips verified by real-tool byte-compare. A data-loss import bug was found and fixed mid-campaign.
spend: $0 (local Vite dev build, no paid APIs)
environment: Vite dev @ localhost:9377, chrome-devtools MCP (isolated context browser-campaigns)

sections.title: Hover reveals rename / export / delete icons
sections.body: Hovering a non-active project card reveals all three action icons. Verified the action container computes opacity:1 and pointerEvents:auto on hover, and that rename/export/delete buttons are present.

screenshots.caption: Trialbook Alpha hovered — 3 icons visible; Import button always shown (Test 6)

sections.title: Export dropdown shows two modes and dismisses on outside click
sections.body: Clicking the export icon opens a dropdown with 'Full project' and 'Outputs only'. A mousedown outside the dropdown dismisses it (confirmed after the React re-render).

sections.title: Full-project export ZIP structure
sections.body: Full export produced a 3626-byte ZIP. Real-tool unzip confirms project.json at root, a sources/ folder with both original .txt files, and an outputs/ folder with both generated .md files plus 00-index.md.

sections.title: Outputs-only export is flat .md-only
sections.body: Outputs-only export produced a 1423-byte ZIP containing only [01-jury-selection.md, 02-opening-statements.md, 00-index.md] at root. No folders, no project.json, no sources. (all_md_at_root=True, has_project_json=False, has_folders=False.)

sections.title: Export spinner renders during processing
sections.body: A MutationObserver on the export button captured the spinner SVG (circle[stroke-dasharray] with animation:spin) appearing while the export ran, then reverting to the normal download icon on completion.

sections.title: Import button always visible
sections.body: The 'Import project' button is rendered unconditionally in the expanded project list (not hover-gated). Present in every a11y snapshot.

sections.title: Import from ZIP creates a new project (original name)
sections.body: Feeding a non-colliding full ZIP through the real hidden file input (change event) created 'Trialbook Imported' with its original name, 2 chapters, 2 restored outputs, and restored source blobs.

screenshots.caption: Imported project appears in the list

sections.title: Name-collision auto-rename
sections.body: Importing a ZIP whose project name matches an existing project appends ' (2)', then ' (3)' on a second import — no overwrite, no prompt. Original project retained.

screenshots.caption: Trialbook Alpha, Trialbook Alpha (2), Trialbook Alpha (3) all present

sections.title: Import status feedback
sections.body: Captured status transitions during import: 'Importing...' (muted) then 'Project imported successfully.' in green (#10b981, rgb(16,185,129)), auto-clearing. Error path renders red (Test 10).

sections.title: Invalid-file rejection
sections.body: Both invalid inputs are rejected in red with no project created: (a) a non-ZIP file, and (b) a ZIP with only readme.txt -> 'Unrecognized ZIP format: expected project.json or .md files.' BORDERLINE: the non-ZIP case surfaces JSZip's raw internal message ('Can't find end of central directory : is this a zip file ? If it is, see https://...'), which is developer-facing. Functionally correct; recommend a friendlier message. Logged as a non-blocking follow-up.

sections.title: Export → import round-trip is byte-identical (after data-loss fix)
sections.body:
Round-trip verified by byte-compare: re-exporting the imported copy produced sources/* and outputs/* byte-identical to the original export (all 5 payload files), and project.json content-equal ignoring volatile id/name/timestamps/blobIds.

DATA-LOSS BUG FOUND & FIXED: importProject reused the chapter blobIds embedded in project.json. The IndexedDB `files` store is keyed by blobId, so importing a project whose blobIds already existed overwrote (re-parented) the existing blob records, silently deleting the original project's source files. Confirmed live: both the original and first import ended with 0 stored blobs. Fix: importProject now regenerates a fresh blobId + chapter id per chapter on import. Regression test added (exportImport Test 11); full suite 120/120 green; post-fix live re-run shows all projects retaining their own source blobs.
